faqs.a:
The board is authorized to purchase an annuity contract for any member, retirant,
               beneficiary, member on permanent disability status, former member who elects a deferred
               monthly benefit; or any other person entitled to a benefit; provided, however, that
               any such person for whom any annuity contract is purchased authorizes such purchase
               in writing. The board is authorized to adopt and promulgate rules and regulations
               relating to the purchase of annuity contracts.
(Code 1981, § 26-87; Ord. No. 2227, § 8, 10-21-1985)
